results.title: A Bobby alternative that fills in your list · Subscriptrack
results.content:
## When Subscriptrack is the better choice

 You suspect you are paying for things you have forgotten.
 You do not want to type in every plan and date, or keep them up to date.
 You use Android or Windows as well as an iPhone, or want your list in a browser.
 You want to hear about price rises and trial ends without watching for them.

## What Subscriptrack does not do

It is not an offline phone app, and it needs a receipt or statement to find anything by itself. It also costs more than a one-off purchase, because reading receipts has a running cost. If you only want a tidy list you keep yourself, it is more than you need.

# A Bobby alternative that fills in your list

Bobby is an iPhone app for keeping a list of your subscriptions. You pick each service and enter the details yourself. With Subscriptrack you connect your email, and it reads your receipts and builds the list for you. The right choice depends on how many you have, and on whether you already know what they are.

Updated 10 November 2026

## What it costs in the US

Subscriptrack is free for up to 5 subscriptions, with no card. Pro, which you can try free for 14 days, is from £4.99 a month, or £39 a year, or £9.99 once for a 30-day pass. We set prices in pounds, and you can pay in dollars at checkout, where the rate and any conversion fee are shown before you pay. Your list shows totals in dollars. Checkout runs through Link, from Stripe, so your statement shows LINK.COM.

## Questions [...] ## What Americans tend to lose track of

 Streaming services added for one show, then left running.
 Delivery memberships such as DashPass and Instacart+ that renew whether you order or not.
 Annual memberships, which charge a large amount once a year with little warning.
 Free trials and promo prices that roll into the full price.
 App store subscriptions, which appear on your card under Apple or Google and not the app's name.

## No Plaid, no bank login

Most US subscription apps ask you to link your bank through a data service. We take a different route. Forward your receipts, connect an Outlook inbox, or upload a PDF or CSV card statement. We read only what you send. [...] ## Read next

results.title: Terms of service · Subscriptrack
results.content:
## Free plan

The free plan needs no payment card. It tracks up to 5subscriptions, with renewal and trial-ending alerts by email, and reads up to 20 forwarded emails and 2 uploaded files a month. Subscriptions an import finds beyond that are saved and listed by name, and are tracked again if you upgrade. Every other feature needs a paid plan, the free trial or a 30-day pass.

We may change the free plan's limits or features. We will tell you by email at least 30 days before a change that reduces what it includes. We never delete your data because of a change, and you can always export it or delete your account.

## 4. Trial, fees and payment [...] Subscriptrackreads receipts you forward, receipts in an inbox you connect, and statements you upload, and turns them into a list of your subscriptions with totals, renewal dates, alerts and cancellation guidance. It is an information tool. It does not connect to your bank, move money, cancel subscriptions or ask for refunds on your behalf. It asks whether you use your subscriptions and whether to keep, downgrade or cancel a yearly renewal, but your answers change nothing with the company. It can write a cancellation or refund email for you to check and send yourself; that wording is general information, not legal advice, and what the company does with it is up to the company. Warnings about charges after you cancel cover only the receipts and statements that reach us, so they cannot show
